newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ registered unemployed up 4.4 pct in December.
newsitem.headline: NZ registered unemployed up 4.4 pct in December.

text.p: The number of registered unemployed New Zealanders rose 4.4 percent to 166,164 in December, Employment Minister Peter McCardle said on Thursday.
McCardle said the increase followed traditional patterns for this time of the year.
"Increases are expected at this time of the year because of the influx of school leavers and people leaving tertiary courses," McCardle said in a statement.
"Although any rise in the register is disappointing, it is interesting to note that this is the smallest December increase over six years," he said.
